scope: Post-hoc inspection of all five weak production crop proposals in the fresh32 study. Original primary result and every existing crop remain unchanged. All five source/crop/body/mask rows inspected. No training, threshold changes, manual crop rescue or template fitting.
finding: Switching to saliency on every weak production crop is insufficient. Saliency sometimes selects the interior motif rather than the paper body; the locator also assumes each exposed lobe is a coherent paper color, which printed sheets violate. The one gained proposal still has a poor material mask.

observations.locatorReason: Could not identify both exposed lower paper edges. Try a rough selection around one complete heart.
observations.visualObservation: Open basket and contents do not form a planar square; neural saliency includes contents and hand. No crop.

The neural field covers the whole heart and ribbon, and produces a supported crop. Rectified classification still follows dots and printed stripes, so improved body detection does not resolve sheet identity. No new fit was run.

observations.locatorReason: Crowded frame: select one heart with a rough rectangle
observations.visualObservation: The pretrained saliency map emphasizes the house motif while omitting most surrounding white/gold paper. The locator reports a crowded frame, but this is a learned-foreground failure on a single heart, not evidence of multiple hearts in the original photograph.

observations.locatorReason: The two-colour foreground does not clearly support both heart lobes and lower edges.
observations.visualObservation: The neural field visibly covers the whole HO HO heart, but the color-dependent lobe model rejects it. The sheets have similar pale base colors and contrasting printing. Removing the lobe gate would not fix the downstream material mask.

observations.locatorReason: Could not identify both exposed lower paper edges. Try a rough selection around one complete heart.
observations.visualObservation: The neural field includes lobes but underweights much of the red body around the candlestick. Lower-edge identification fails; simply replacing the weak production proposal with this detector gives no crop.

nextWork: Use reviewed whole-paper supervision, with source-group separation, if adapting the pretrained network; generic foreground is not equivalent to the heart paper body.
Diagnose outline-only geometry for correctly segmented printed-paper bodies separately from material reconstruction. Do not count a good crop as a solved heart.
Explore lobe-conditioned material/texture identity so dots, stripes and lettering are not mistaken for cutting boundaries. Keep the blue/red printed example as a control.
